verdict: Paid ads have not launched yet; organic channels are holding steady.
narrative: No paid activity ran across Meta or Google in the last 28 days — zero spend, zero paid leads — because key launch milestones originally scheduled for July 31–August 1 have not yet been completed. Your Google Business Profile remained the sole source of direct engagement, delivering 88 actions this period including 17 calls, 27 direction requests, and 44 website clicks. Instagram reach across the period was 28,862, though engagement dropped roughly 32% over the most recent 7 days, likely tied to posting cadence. We are moving now to clear the remaining pre-launch items — stack verification, landing pages, and ad account setup — so that paid search and Meta campaigns can go live. Once ads are running, you should begin seeing paid lead volume reflected in next period's report.
